comparison.objective: Commission and lock a damper versus remove a funnel, park it on a drip tray, and recap a hazardous-waste jug.
comparison.physical_skill: Hex-key insertion, counterholding, collar tuning, and bounded tightening versus funnel extraction, placement, cap alignment, and threaded closure.
comparison.success_condition: Measured stopping behavior and post-lock drift tolerance versus funnel out, on tray, and cap screwed on. The record supplies no specs or closure threshold.
comparison.reason: Threaded cap closure is only a generic rotary primitive and does not establish overlap with iterative damper tuning.
